thesis: Buying an extended, post-gap small cap into a confirmed risk-off tape (VIX percentile 0.981, QQQ below its 50- and 200-day averages) is poor timing. The stock is far above SMA20 and SMA50, the range top at 9.70 has already rejected price, and reward/risk of 1.74 is below 2 for a 5% ATR name. Officers are selling repeatedly with another sale planned, and the only sell-side targets (mean 4.73) sit far below price, so there is no analyst support. Forward P/E above trailing P/E implies the market expects earnings to fall after one strong quarter that follows two down-year-over-year quarters. A failure of the 8.09 swing low opens the gap-fill area near 7.0.
